page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: dedication title block centred in italic and capitals. Below it: a short italic salutation line, then the body text beginning with a woodcut initial. A catchword or asterisk-numeral mark "* 2" stands at the foot of the column, left of the last word. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Nobili & Amplissimo Viro Domino D. NICOLAO ST.AEFVENISSE, Civitatis Vlissinganæ Senatori & Syndico: Ab illustr. & Præpot. D. D. Ordinibus Zelandiæ ad Comitia Ordinum Generalium Delegato.
Nobilis & Amplissime Vir.
main_text.p: VIROS principes & magistratum gerentes, literis operam navare, & tetricis ac difficilibus Reipublicæ negotiis, otium illud honestum & blan-

page.notes: The woodcut initial V is ornamental and is read as V. The "* 2" mark at the foot is a signature mark, placed under the text. The word "blan-" is hyphenated at the line end and continues on the next page. The body text is printed in roman type with the first word in small capitals ("IROS" as printed "IROS"); the apparent initial letter is a woodcut. Edges of the page show show-through and a dark scan border, which are not transcribed.
